title: Daily Deed: Storeroom 4A
description: Daily Deed: Storeroom 4A — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Janitor

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Go Kill all of Abaddon's Ciphers in the Storeroom 4A Cellar and return to Mopicles in Storeroom 4A.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Janitor

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go Kill all of Abaddon's Ciphers in the Storeroom 4A Cellar and return to Mopicles in Storeroom 4A.

Offer:

Ho, Dungeon Runner. I am Mopicles! I know what your thinking: this guy is a janitor? No, I'm actually a Janiator. I have half my skill bar filled with crazy melee skills and the other half is all mad whack janitor skills. My full title is actually Lazy Close-to-Retirement Gassy Janiator. It's more of a player versus eyesore build, but if the devs ever make a PvP play type that focuses up on mopping, you'd be dead meat!

Anyway, I actually need a favor from you. I need to get down to the Storeroom 4A Cellar to get it cleaned up as part of my daily tasks, but the cellar is currently full of Abaddon's Ciphers. These mobs just hang out in their sarcophagi and meditate to focus their dark powers which in turn powers The Embercore's Candy Fabricators. You would be doing me and the King's Board of Trustees a solid if you were to get in there and shut those ciphers down.

Head into the Storeroom 4A Cellar and kill all of Abaddon's Ciphers there to clear out the dungeon and hit Abaddon's candy making ability in one fell swoop! When you have finished with this task, return to me, Mopicles, here in Storeroom 4A.

Turn-in:

You cleared the area out for me? Excellent! Time to put my trusty Pine-Fresh Mop of the Luminescent Shine to work! Come back tomorrow and see if I need your help again.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abaddon's Ciphers
  • Storeroom 4A Cellar Door Key ×1

Level range: 40–100
